cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import compiler
from compiler import participant_distance, Router, _adjacency, _candidate_orders, _decompose_trees, _origin_orders
m=24
links=[(i,i+1) for i in range(m-1)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
caps=[24]*(m-1)
n=m
dist,pdist=participant_distance(n,links,parts,caps)
names=[p[0] for p in parts]
adj,Cset=_adjacency(n,links,caps,parts)
router=Router(n,links,caps); recipes=[];memo={}; routes=[]
origins=_origin_orders(n,links,caps,parts)[0]
for (v,rv) in origins:
    others=[w for w in names if w!=v]
    done=None
    for order in _candidate_orders(v,others,dist,adj,Cset,pdist):
        if set(order)!=set(others) or len(order)!=len(others): continue
        for strict in (False,True):
            saved=list(router.res); sr=len(routes); src=len(recipes); sm=dict(memo)
            res=compiler._deliver(router,v,rv,order,names,n,dist,recipes,memo,strict,pdist)
            ok=res is not None
            if ok:
                recs=_decompose_trees(v,rv,res[0],parts)
                if recs is None: ok=False
            if not ok:
                router.res=saved; del routes[sr:]; del recipes[src:]; memo.clear(); memo.update(sm); continue
            done=(res,recs); break
        if done: break
    if done is None:
        print('origin',v,'FAIL'); break
    (lv,flows),recs=done
    trees=recs
    for (u,w,cnt,rid) in flows: routes.append([u,w,cnt,rid])
    print('origin',v,'ok trees',len(trees),'routes',len(routes))
